Guidance & outlook: So my question would be, sir, you gave a guidance last quarter that of USD 100 million in FY27 and USD 200 million in FY28 from this segment.
I just wanted to ask you about your USD 100 million and USD 200 million guidance for CrudeChem.

Now if I compare this 132 crores with 137 crores reported in Q1 of ‘26, I think there is Fineotex Chemicals Limited July 24, 2026 still a dip, whereas we were anticipating better numbers in textile business.
Growth & demand: The total income for the quarter stood at INR 386.72 crores compared with INR 146.62 crores in the quarter 1 financial year '26, registering a 165% year -on-year growth, driven by full quarter contribution from the U.S.A. operations together with healthy growth across domestic businesses.
EBITDA stood at INR 59.14 crores for the quarter compared with INR 25.2 crores in quarter 1 financial year '26, registering 134.7% Y-o-Y growth while the EBITDA margin stood at 15.70%.
Profit after tax stood at INR 48.21 crores compared with INR 25.03 crores in quarter 1 financial year '26, representing a 92.67% Y-o-Y growth.
Margins & costs: Under Fineotex's management, the U.S.A. operations has achieved meaningful improvements in operational efficiency, capacity utilization, execution capabilities and other scalability, resulting in a significant expansion in EBITDA margin.

The gross profit has increased to INR 133.4 crores compared to INR 45.96 crores in quarter 1 financial year '26, while the gross margins improved to 35.42%, reflecting the company's ability to successfully pass on higher raw material costs while maintaining healthy blended margins.

During the quarter, despite the volatility in the global raw material prices arising from geopolitical developments in the Middle East, we successfully passed on the increased input cost to customers, thereby preserving healthy blended margins.
Capex & expansion: During this quarter, we commissioned a major expansion -- capacity expansion at our Texas manufacturing facility, increasing the total manufacturing capacity to approximately 148,000 metric tons per year.
Sir the company has undertaken significant capex to add 69,000 MTPA of capacity at your Texas facility, increasing the plant capacity...

Sir, you've undertaken significant capex to add 69,000 MTP A of capacity at your Texas facility, increasing the total capacity to -- from 80,000 MTP A to 1,48,000 MTP A a nd consequently the company's total capacity has expanded to 2,68,000 MTPA.
Balance sheet & cash: Our working capital cycle stood at 72 days, reflecting disciplined capital management while supporting the scale of our international operation.
Just congratulations again on maintaining the working capital or reducing the working capital cycle to 72 days.
And the working capital is controlled, everything is going fantastic.
Risks & challenges: While geopolitical development and raw material volatility continue to create near -term uncertainties, the underlying demand environment remains encouraging, supported by improving exports, healthy domestic consumption and increasing demand for value -added textile solutions.
And just a last question related to if I see your standalone business, standalone revenue and EBITDA, it has shown some marginal decline.
And also there are certain products which was of the competition in the textile industry.
